_meta.scope: Destination registry: currency, import tax (VAT/GST/sales tax) standard rate and base, official tariff lookup, and how far our duty data goes. Tier 'verified' = checked against real declarations; 'official' = loaded from the national schedule; 'indicative' = standard import tax only, duty % entered by the user (or from WITS/TRAINS when loaded).
_meta.tax_base_note: cif_plus_duty = tax on CIF + customs duty (+ excise where any). Most VAT/GST countries. Exceptions noted per country.
_meta.coverage_note: Rates for countries beyond the first 55 are standard rates from public summaries as of Nov 2026, labelled indicative; each is replaced by the national schedule as it is loaded.
